skills.name: SEO Audit
skills.description: Use when the user wants an SEO audit: Search Console, indexing, on-page, AI traffic, scored findings delivered like an agency deck — not a dump.
skills.content:
---
name: SEO Audit
description: >-
  Use when the user wants an SEO audit: Search Console, indexing, on-page, AI
  traffic, scored findings delivered like an agency deck — not a dump.
---
A scored, prioritized SEO report from LIVE data. Every finding cites a real query, page, or fetched element. Missing source: say so. Never invent impressions, position, or clicks.

## Connector
If the Ryze AI connector is missing, stop. Add `https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp` (docs: https://www.get-ryze.ai/how-to-connect-claude-to-google-meta-ads-mcp). Wait.

List connections first. No Search Console → say what it unlocks (queries, rankings) and offer a reduced audit (on-page + fetched pages). Do not stall. GA4 connected → rank by money and pull AI-referral traffic. No GA4 → skip that slice, do not fake it.

## Flow
1. Scope. Confirm the GSC property. Two windows: last 28 days vs prior 28. State property + window in one line before digging.
2. Young site. GSC near-empty → say it once. Weight indexing, on-page of key pages, competitor/keyword gap. Do not pad empty sections.
3. Queries. High impressions + weak CTR (title/meta). Striking distance 11–20, ranked by impressions. Branded vs non-branded. Decay vs prior window. One device pull, one country pull.
4. Pages. Top landings by clicks — are these the pages the business wants? Impression-heavy / click-poor. Single-query pages (thin coverage). Join GA4 conversions if present so money reorders the list.
5. Indexing. Sitemap summary. Inspect 2–3 key URLs (submitted-not-indexed, crawled-not-indexed).
6. On-page. Fetch at most 5 pages. For each: title + meta present/unique/aligned to the query it actually ranks for; one h1; canonical; structure.
7. AI visibility. Only with GA4: ChatGPT / Perplexity / Gemini sessions, landings, trend. Its own beat, not a footnote.
8. Score 0–100, honest: indexing 20, query capture 20, on-page 20, coverage 15, technical/off-page 15, trend 10. 90+ excellent, 70–89 good, 50–69 needs work, <50 critical. A flattering score kills the follow-up.

Cap the run: two GSC windows, one device, one country, 5 page fetches, one AI pull. Depth is analysis, not more pulls.

## How it reads
Pick ONE visual identity and keep it (Bold Signal / Electric Studio / Dark Botanical / Vintage Editorial). Cover title is the conclusion, not "SEO Report". One idea per beat. Numbers first. Section titles are claims: "Pricing sits at position 11 on 41k impressions".

Lead with the score and three opportunities ranked by click/revenue impact. Close with P0 / P1 and expected impact.

## Writes
Offer the top on-page fixes one at a time, exact new title/meta. Never write a CMS, sitemap, or live page without a yes on that change.

skills.name: Ads Audit
skills.description: Use when the user wants a Google Ads or Meta audit. Propose only. Findings must clear a money bar and read like a decision, not a dashboard.
skills.content:
---
name: Ads Audit
description: >-
  Use when the user wants a Google Ads or Meta audit. Propose only. Findings
  must clear a money bar and read like a decision, not a dashboard.
---
Hunt concrete paid-ads problems. You only propose. Never apply, pause, bid, or delete in this skill.

## Connector
If the Ryze AI connector is missing, stop. Add `https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp` (docs: https://www.get-ryze.ai/how-to-connect-claude-to-google-meta-ads-mcp). Wait.

List connections. Use the accounts they named. None named → workspace defaults, and say which.

## Pull
Current vs prior (default last 7 vs prior 7). Slice below campaign: search terms, placements, schedule, device, geo, ads/creatives. Campaign totals are context, not findings.

Google money is micros ÷ 1,000,000. Meta Graph money is often minor units ÷ 100, except Insights `spend` (already whole). Empty or all-zero Insights is not zero spend — recheck the window. Never invent spend, CPA, or ROAS.

## The bar
An empty run is a good run. "Could be better" is not a finding.
A finding needs: exact entity name, real numbers over a real window, a from → to change, honest impact.
Skip paused, ended, zero-delivery. Skip idle cleanup.
Materiality: about $100/month measured waste, or ~3% of monthly spend, whichever is larger.
At most three findings, worst first. One root cause = one finding.

## Hunt, in order
A. Money burning — broken conversion tracking, disapproved ads, search terms/placements with spend and zero conversions, hours/geos/devices with CPA at a multiple of account average.
B. Money missed — converting search terms with no exact keyword; budget-capped campaigns losing impression share to *budget* (not rank) with strong ROAS. Small reversible step, never a double.
C. Hygiene — fatigued creatives, one ad eating all spend, overlapping audiences. Only if it clears the same money bar.

## How a finding reads
Five pieces or it is not a recommendation:
1. Thesis — one sentence, a number from THIS account
2. Evidence — two or three facts with metrics, no adjectives
3. Action — entity, field, from-value, to-value
4. Impact — magnitude + confidence, scoped to a window
5. Watch for — the metric and threshold that would prove it wrong

Title is a claim ("$2.1k/mo on search terms with 0 conversions"). One visual identity. No 20-row tables.

## After the list
Wait for a yes on those exact items. Prefer pause over delete.

skills.name: Generate Creative
skills.description: Use when the user wants ad creatives or images. Hunt real brand assets, copy a real HTML skeleton from the wall, judge renders before showing.
skills.content:
---
name: Generate Creative
description: >-
  Use when the user wants ad creatives or images. Hunt real brand assets, copy a
  real HTML skeleton from the wall, judge renders before showing.
---
You are the strategist. A design model (or image tool) renders. You hunt real context, brief hard, and refuse to show work you would not defend. Never invent the product, the price, or the logo.

## Look at the examples first
Before you brief anything, study the HTML wall below. Copy a skeleton, replace the brand. Do not copy their products, copy, or prices. If a render would fail an anti-example, redo it.

These shipped and were approved. Every document is a complete 1080×1350 creative: `<!doctype html>`, one `<style>`, Google Fonts via `<link>`, `html,body{width:100vw;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}`. Photo refs are `image://https://…` — never a symbolic name like `image://HERO`. No drawn CTA button (Meta draws one). The ad ends on price / offer / proof.

Copy a skeleton from the live skill wall (studio spec, photo-window band, full-bleed proof card, testimonial poster) and replace the brand. Three different skeletons per set. Anti: arrows at photos, clipped leader lines, UI-card props that crop mid-word.

## Connector
If the Ryze AI connector is missing, stop. Add `https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp` (docs: https://www.get-ryze.ai/how-to-connect-claude-to-google-meta-ads-mcp). Wait.

## Ask once
If you do not know what is sold, the offer, the placement, or the style — one short round. They already said "just make it" → hunt and go.

## Hunt — never invent
Product photos first. Real logo, real palette, type from the live site. Prices copied exactly. Default THREE creatives, three different skeletons. Sizes: 1080×1350 default. No CTA button.

Wait for a yes on those exact ads. After any write, re-read the ad.

The four complete HTML documents and the 10 skeleton/anti-example list stay in the Generate Creative skill, not in memory.

name: Build Deck
description: >-
  Use when the user wants a slide deck, audit report, or monthly recap as a
  designed HTML presentation — not a bullet dump.
---
A self-contained HTML slide deck. Agency deliverable, not a purple-gradient AI template. Every number comes from a tool result you actually received. Never invent a figure.

If the Ryze AI connector is missing, stop. Add `https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp`. Wait. No live data → say so and stop; do not mock numbers.

Write one complete HTML file and attach it. Slides 1280×720. Hard cap 20; normal 5–9. One idea per slide. Never mix identities: Bold Signal, Electric Studio, Dark Botanical, Vintage Editorial, Terminal Mono.

Cover title is the conclusion. Numbers first. No purple gradients, no cards-in-cards.

Look at the file before you hand it over.
